alt: A vast column of luminous cloud pours down out of a deep blue sky into the cleft of a jade mountain ridge, filling the gorge and billowing back out of it.
scene: Wide painted landscape, low worm's-eye angle from the valley floor. A great jade-green mountain ridge with a single deep, narrow cleft running down its centre between two rounded shoulders of rock, pines along the rims. Out of a deep ultramarine #1e4d9c sky a single enormous column of white luminous cloud plunges down and pushes deep into the cleft, filling the gorge to the brim, mist surging back out over both shoulders of the ridge in slow heavy rolls, pines bent all one way by the push. At the foot of the cleft a hot spring has burst from the rock, a thin white plume of steam. Violet #c084fc light glows along the wet rims of the ridge where the cloud presses against it. Rain streaks drift upward. One hard break of low gold light from the side. Huge, slow, sensual landscape.

alt: The sun hangs impossibly low over the Amnok, almost touching the water, and the whole river steams up in white plumes beneath it.
scene: Wide painted river landscape at golden hour, camera low at the waterline. The Amnok river, broad and glassy between dark wet boulders and reed banks. The sun hangs impossibly LOW and HUGE, a molten gold #f0b429 disc sitting just above the river's surface, close enough that the water directly beneath it has begun to boil: thick white steam rises off the river in tall curling plumes, the surface trembling and rippling outward in rings, droplets thrown up and lit gold. The steam rolls downstream in a long soft veil. A tiny copper-roofed room on the far bank glows warm through the haze. Pale ice-blue #8fc4e0 in the cool water at the frame edges, gold everywhere the sun touches. One sun, one river, one plume. Hot, heavy, sensual stillness.

at: The household learns the sound of a door
alt: Extreme close-up by lamplight: a magenta silk thread sliding through the eye of a pink needle.
scene: Extreme close-up macro still life, shallow depth of field. A slim pink #E07FA8 enamelled needle held upright in the dark, its eye in razor-sharp focus. A single magenta #D8258C silk thread, glossy and slightly frayed at its tip, is sliding slowly into and through the narrow eye of the needle, the thread just pushing out the far side. A warm oil lamp flame just out of frame to the left rakes across the needle's polished side and the twist of the silk. Behind, creamy out-of-focus bokeh of lamp glints and folds of magenta and pink silk in an umber-dark room. Intimate, slow, suggestive.

at: The lamp burns down. Neither of them gets up to fix it.
alt: At night a small gold butterfly pushes deep into the heart of an open plum blossom, scattering pollen in the moonlight.
scene: Extreme close-up still life at night. A single branch of old gnarled plum wood with one fully open five-petalled white-and-sage plum blossom (maehwa), petals spread wide and trembling. A small butterfly of hammered gold, delicate openwork wings, has pushed its body deep into the heart of the blossom, wings pressed open, gold legs gripping the petals; a burst of pollen dust spills from the stamens and drifts glowing in the air. Cold ice-blue #7EB8F0 moonlight from above grazes the petals; a warm guttering lamp glow from below catches the gold. Sage green #8AAFA0 in the leaves and the blurred background, crushed black night beyond, a few fallen petals on dark timber below. Delicate, intimate, suggestive.

alt: By moonlight a red-sailed ship glides slowly into a narrow cove between two dark headlands, its prow parting the still water.
scene: Wide painted seascape at night, camera low on the water. Two dark rounded headlands curve toward each other, leaving a narrow, sheltered cove of still black water between them, a sandy beach at its far end with one warm lamp glowing in a tent. A tall ship under a single great red sail glides slowly into the cove, its prow parting the glassy water in a long V-shaped wake, the sail full and curved, lamplight from the shore catching its edge. Thousands of tiny floating river-lamps drift out of the cove around the hull. Purple-violet #d98fa8 night sky with a low moon, warm amber #e0a33c lamplight on the water. Slow, heavy, inevitable, sensual.

at: He spends himself in her against the grain sacks
alt: In a lamp-lit grain room an arrow is driven deep into a full sack of millet, and the grain pours out of the split in a golden stream.
scene: Close still life in a dark timber grain room, low angle at sack height. A stack of fat hemp sacks bulging with millet. One arrow with red #e8563f fletching is driven deep into the topmost sack, buried almost to the feathers, the shaft still quivering; the hemp has split around it and millet pours out of the wound in a heavy golden stream, piling and bouncing on the packed-earth floor. A single oil lamp on a sack beside it is the hard warm key, dusty-gold #e8a04a light raking across the grain stream and the strained weave of the sacks. Dust motes and flying grains as glowing bokeh, crushed umber dark beyond. Hot, sudden, suggestive.

at: She moves his hand to the inside of her wrist
alt: On the moonlit wall-walk Maehwa holds Pumsuk's shaking hand against the inside of her wrist, watching his face, while he forgets to breathe.
scene: Romance still, intimate medium-close two-shot, low three-quarter angle from the parapet steps. Midnight on the stone wall-walk above the river, the moon on the water far below as soft bokeh. Maehwa (thirty-one) sits on the warm parapet step in her washed-out old green jeogori and red sash, a shawl slipping off her knees, and holds young Pumsuk's hand pressed to the inside of her bare wrist, her head tilted, a slow dare of a smile, eyes on his face. Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, black hair in a topknot) sits too stiffly an arm's length away in an ice-blue silk robe, his free fist clenched on his knee, flushed red to the ears, lips parted, staring at their hands. A small gold butterfly glints in her other fist. ONE device: a small oil lamp set on the step between them, its warm key raking up across both faces; cold ice-blue #7EB8F0 moonlight edge along his shoulder. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers on Pumsuk.

at: He catches her on the landing under his own door
alt: On a dark stair landing Pumsuk has caught Maehwa by the waist and pressed her to the timber wall; she laughs into his collar.
scene: Romance still, dramatic dutch angle, medium-close, looking up the narrow timber stair from below. A steep dark wooden stair inside a fortress tower; a small cold-lamp doorway glows at the top. On the landing Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, topknot coming loose, ice-blue silk robe) has caught Maehwa (thirty-one, old green jeogori, red sash) by the wrist and the waist and pressed her back against the timber wall, his face flushed and desperate, jaw tight, breathing hard. She has her head tipped back against the wood, laughing into his collar, one hand fisted in his robe, eyes half-closed, utterly unafraid; the gold butterfly dangling from her fingers. ONE device: the hard diagonal of the stair rail cutting the frame, their two bodies pressed into the corner it makes. A torch on the wall below throws warm light up across them; ice-blue #7EB8F0 catch on his silk. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers on Pumsuk.

at: waiting for his wife to wake up, so that he can lie to her first
alt: At grey dawn Pumsuk sits alone on the floor of a corridor outside a door with a pink ribbon tied to its post, his face in his hands.
scene: Quiet still, low angle from the corridor floor, long receding timber corridor. Grey dawn light through a paper lattice at the far end. Pumsuk (twenty-one, beardless, bare-headed, hair disordered, ice-blue silk robe hastily tied, no belt ornament) sits on the bare floorboards with his back against the wall beside a closed door, knees up, staring at nothing, one hand pressed over his mouth. On the door post beside his head hangs a small pink silk ribbon, tied in a bow, in sharp focus in the foreground. ONE device: the pink ribbon as the only warm colour in a cold grey-blue corridor. A single candle stub guttering on the floor beside him rakes light up his face; his long shadow climbs the timber wall. Ice-blue #7EB8F0 as the cold dawn. No jougwan, no cap, no feathers.

at: So he walks her round the outside of it.
alt: At night King Suro walks with Heo along the outside of his new timber palace wall; on the dark side, her shoulder has found his arm.
scene: Romance still, low three-quarter tracking two-shot. Night outside a new timber palace wall in Golden Gaya: raw resin-bright planks, a tiled gate far behind with two torches as round bokeh, the rest of the wall in blue darkness, the sea glinting beyond. Suro (young king, no crown, in a plain dark coat, hair loose at the neck) walks beside Heo Hwang-ok (twenty-one, dark gold-brown skin, in close-fitted purple silk cut to the waist and hip, a bared shoulder at most), her shoulder pressed to his arm, her face turned up to him with a composed amused half-smile; he is looking straight ahead, flushed, rigid, visibly forgetting how to walk. ONE device: the long raking diagonal of the palace wall, torchlight behind, dark where they walk. A small hand lamp she carries low at hip height is the warm key raking up across both faces; amber #e0a33c on his coat, violet-rose #d98fa8 sheen on her silk.

alt: In the dark of the palace wall Suro's hand has settled at Heo's waist on the purple silk; she keeps walking, smiling, as if it were weather.
scene: Romance still, close, over-the-shoulder from behind Heo. In the foreground, soft focus: the curve of Heo's purple silk at the waist and hip, close-fitted, Suro's large hand resting there, fingers spread, careful. In the midground, razor-sharp: Suro's face, young and flushed, mouth open as if he has lost a word, eyes on her. Heo looks back over her shoulder at him with a slow, composed, amused smile, one brow raised, the gold of her binyeo catching light. Timber palace wall behind them, night, the sea glittering through a gap as bokeh. ONE device: her hand lamp held low between them, warm light rising across his face and her silk. Amber #e0a33c, violet-rose #d98fa8. Clothed, sensual by charge, never explicit.
